name: DOLICHOS PRURIENS
gi_symptoms: Colic from getting feet wet. Constipation, with intense itching; bloated abdomen. White stools. Swelling of liver. Hćmorrhoids, with burning sensation.
skin_symptoms: Intense itching, with no swelling or rash; worse across shoulders, also about elbows and knees and hairy parts. Jaundice. Yellow in spots; itching excessively at night. Herpes zoster (Ars).

source.title: DOLICHOS PRURIENS - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
